name: benchmark_ReFineID_FIM
description: Benchmark for fine-grained image-based identification and re-identification tasks, evaluating models on their ability to match and retrieve instances across images under variations in viewpoint, occlusion, and appearance. It provides standardized splits and evaluation protocols for measuring retrieval and identification performance. Useful for assessing model robustness in re-identification / instance-matching scenarios.
evaluation_method: mean average precision (mAP) and Rank-1 accuracy
reputation: A niche benchmark used within the re-identification research community for fine-grained instance matching; moderate recognition among specialists.
